whatIs: Vengeance UI is a collection of animated React components designed for marketing sites: hover effects, animated tooltips, and layouts that react to scroll. It includes about 46 components in nine families, plus blocks and templates.
You add them with the shadcn CLI, so the code ends up in your project. It's a good fit if you already use React or Next.js and want to bring a landing page to life without coding the animations.
uses: Adding hover effects and animated tooltips to a landing page's buttons.
Building a product section with a layout that changes as you scroll.
Starting from a block template to quickly launch a campaign site.
caveats: It's aimed at React and Next.js; outside that ecosystem it won't be useful.
These are eye-catching marketing effects, not a foundation of form or dashboard components.
The animations add weight and motion, so test performance on modest mobile devices.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license, with no paid plans.
idealFor: React or Next.js landing pages that need animated interactions.
